nodes.description: DigitechNetwork constructor (payable): mints the whole MAX_SUPPLY to the deployer and initialises name/symbol/decimals.
totalSupply(): view returning the current _totalSupply, which shrinks with every 1% burn.
balanceOf(address owner): view returning _DGCBalance[owner].
transfer(address to,uint256 value): debits the caller, credits `to` with value-(value/100) and burns the 1% remainder while supply is above the MAX_REMAIN floor.
distribute(address to,uint256 value): privileged, burn-free transfer that may only be executed by the hard-coded RWALLET address.
allowance(address owner,address target): view returning _allowed[owner][target].
approve(address target,uint256 value): overwrites _allowed[msg.sender][target] unconditionally.
transferFrom(address from,address to,uint256 value): consumes allowance and applies the same 1% burn logic as transfer().
increaseAllowance(address target,uint256 addedValue): SafeMath-protected increase of the caller's allowance.
decreaseAllowance(address target,uint256 val): SafeMath-protected decrease of the caller's allowance.
_mint(address account,uint256 amount): internal credit of balances only; it never touches _totalSupply.
burn(uint256 amount): external entry point that burns the caller's own tokens through _sendBurn.
_sendBurn(address account,uint256 amount): internal burn that decreases both _totalSupply and _DGCBalance[account].
burnFrom(address account,uint256 amount): spends _allowed[account][msg.sender] and then burns the tokens of `account`.
_DGCBalance: mapping(address=>uint256) holding every token balance; the single source of ownership truth.
_allowed: mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) ERC20 allowance table.
_totalSupply: uint256 supply initialised to MAX_SUPPLY*10**18 and monotonically reduced by burns.
MAX_SUPPLY: constant 33333 (millions of tokens) used to derive the initial supply.
MAX_REMAIN: constant 8888 (millions) defining the supply floor under which the 1% burn is disabled.
BURN_RATE: constant 100, i.e. 1% of every transfer/transferFrom is burned.
TOKEN_DECIMAL: constant 18 used as the 10**18 scaling factor.
RWALLET: constant privileged address 0xF212A3A9a201B8Ced41AaF783942285E928988ae authorised for distribute().
msg.sender inside the constructor: the deployer that receives the entire initial supply.
msg.sender inside transfer(): the account whose balance is checked and debited.
msg.sender inside distribute(): the only identity compared against the RWALLET constant.
msg.sender inside approve(): owner of the allowance entry being overwritten.
msg.sender inside transferFrom(): spender whose allowance is consumed.
msg.sender inside increaseAllowance(): owner of the allowance being raised.
msg.sender inside decreaseAllowance(): owner of the allowance being lowered.
msg.sender inside burn(): forwarded as the account argument of _sendBurn.
msg.sender inside burnFrom(): spender whose allowance is spent before the burn.
Unchecked expression `_totalSupply - MAX_REMAIN * 10 ** uint256(TOKEN_DECIMAL)` in transfer(): native uint256 arithmetic with no SafeMath can silently wrap and corrupt the burn amount.
The identical unchecked `_totalSupply - MAX_REMAIN * 10 ** uint256(TOKEN_DECIMAL)` computation repeated in transferFrom().
distribute() authorization is a single `require(msg.sender == RWALLET)` against a hard-coded constant address with no ownership transfer, renounce or role management.

edges.reason: Constructor calls the internal _mint(msg.sender, _totalSupply) helper to create the whole supply.
burn() forwards execution to the internal _sendBurn helper.
burnFrom() spends allowance and then calls the internal _sendBurn helper.
transfer() executes the unchecked `_totalSupply - MAX_REMAIN * 10 ** TOKEN_DECIMAL` computation.
transferFrom() executes the same unchecked reserve computation.
distribute() is protected only by the `require(msg.sender == RWALLET)` comparison.
msg.sender is the deployer identity consumed by the constructor.
msg.sender is passed as the `account` argument of _mint, so the deployer receives the entire supply.
msg.sender supplies the debited account inside transfer().
msg.sender supplies both the checked identity and the debited account inside distribute().
msg.sender is the sole authorization input compared against the constant RWALLET address.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping written by approve().

msg.sender owns the allowance raised by increaseAllowance().
msg.sender owns the allowance lowered by decreaseAllowance().
msg.sender is consumed by burn() to identify the token holder.
burn() forwards msg.sender as the `account` argument of _sendBurn.
msg.sender is the spender checked in burnFrom() before the allowance is spent.

The constructor mints the entire pre-declared _totalSupply.
totalSupply() reads the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf() reads _DGCBalance[owner].
transfer() reads and writes both the sender and recipient entries of _DGCBalance.
transfer() reads _totalSupply and reduces it by the burn amount.
transfer() divides by BURN_RATE to obtain the 1% burn.
distribute() debits RWALLET and credits the recipient in _DGCBalance.
allowance() reads the _allowed mapping.
approve() writes the _allowed mapping.
transferFrom() reads and writes _DGCBalance for `from` and `to`.
transferFrom() reads and decrements _allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() reads _totalSupply and reduces it by the burn amount.
transferFrom() divides by BURN_RATE to obtain the 1% burn.
increaseAllowance() writes the caller's allowance entry.
decreaseAllowance() writes the caller's allowance entry.
_mint() adds the minted amount to _DGCBalance[account].
_sendBurn() subtracts the burned amount from _DGCBalance[account].
_sendBurn() subtracts the burned amount from _totalSupply.
burnFrom() decrements the spender allowance before burning.
The unchecked subtraction reads _totalSupply without SafeMath, so a wrap-around corrupts the burn cap.
The unchecked subtraction mixes the MAX_REMAIN constant into native uint256 arithmetic.
The unchecked subtraction relies on 10**TOKEN_DECIMAL computed with raw exponentiation.
transferFrom()'s unchecked subtraction reads _totalSupply without SafeMath.
transferFrom()'s unchecked subtraction mixes the MAX_REMAIN constant into native uint256 arithmetic.
transferFrom()'s unchecked subtraction relies on 10**TOKEN_DECIMAL computed with raw exponentiation.
The privileged distribute() path compares msg.sender against the immutable RWALLET constant, so control of that key grants unrestricted non-burning transfers.

normalization_plan.reason: `owner` is only a mapping lookup key and has no independent semantics outside balanceOf(), so it is folded into the balanceOf core function.
`to` of transfer() is fully absorbed by the transfer core function.
`value` of transfer() is fully absorbed by the transfer core function.
`to` of distribute() is fully absorbed by the distribute core function.
`value` of distribute() is fully absorbed by the distribute core function.
`owner` only indexes the allowance table inside allowance().
`target` only indexes the allowance table inside allowance().
`target` of approve() is fully absorbed by the approve core function.
`value` of approve() is fully absorbed by the approve core function.
`from` of transferFrom() is fully absorbed by the transferFrom core function.
`to` of transferFrom() is fully absorbed by the transferFrom core function.
`value` of transferFrom() is fully absorbed by the transferFrom core function.
`target` of increaseAllowance() is fully absorbed by that core function.
`addedValue` of increaseAllowance() is fully absorbed by that core function.
`target` of decreaseAllowance() is fully absorbed by that core function.
`val` of decreaseAllowance() is fully absorbed by that core function.
`account` of _mint() is fully absorbed by the internal mint function.
`amount` of _mint() is fully absorbed by the internal mint function.
`amount` of burn() is fully absorbed by the burn entry point.
`account` of _sendBurn() is fully absorbed by that internal burn helper.
`amount` of _sendBurn() is fully absorbed by that internal burn helper.
`account` of burnFrom() is fully absorbed by the burnFrom core function.
`amount` of burnFrom() is fully absorbed by the burnFrom core function.
Local `_d` is a transient burn amount that only exists inside transfer().
Local `a` exists solely as the result of the unchecked reserve subtraction, so it merges directly into that unsafe arithmetic operation.
Local `_transfer` is a transient net amount that only exists inside transfer().
Local `_d` is a transient burn amount that only exists inside transferFrom().
Local `a` in transferFrom() is the direct product of the unchecked reserve subtraction and merges into that unsafe arithmetic operation.
Local `_transfer` is a transient net amount that only exists inside transferFrom().
